description: Run your PrestaShop store from workflows: get and find orders, move them to a new status and add tracking numbers, find and add customers, and keep stock and prices in step with your other systems. Start a workflow on a new order, a status change or a new customer.

prestashop_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when someone makes an account in your shop or checks out as a guest.

prestashop_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order is placed in your shop, with what was ordered, the customer, the addresses and the status.

prestashop_order_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an order moves to a new status, or to the one you pick, with the order and the status it had before. A new order's first status counts too.

parameters.description: Only orders moving to this status. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: status
